decisions.reason: Reissued jazz vinyl sits in the firm's core reissue competence and benefits from the vinyl revival, so results likely meet aspirations and the long-tail catalog model means little cost in keeping it listed.

Multi-disc box sets are a signature, high-margin offering for collectors that stay in the warehouse-backed catalog, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall to trigger problemistic search.

The compilation CD is close to the established offer and cheap to keep in stock, but it gets only low visibility in a declining CD format, so the risk of it running out of print or being delisted is somewhat higher.
